visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a monochrome grayscale scene, a large crowd of people is gathered around an outdoor swimming pool on a rooftop. A central couple—a woman in a striped maternity dress and a man in a white T-shirt—hold a long pole supporting a massive, fluffy white cloud-shaped structure. Guests in the foreground are seen from behind, holding up smartphones to capture the moment. (2) The scene shifts to vibrant color. The couple stands under the cloud as pink balloons begin to drop from its underside. The background features palm trees and a clear blue sky with white clouds. (3) Rapid cuts show close-up details of the event preparation: hands using markers to write names on white cloud-shaped cards, a beautifully decorated indoor venue with a large white balloon arch, and a man at a bar preparing multiple colorful bottled beverages. (4) The main female character stands in front of a white balloon arch, wearing a striped dress and smiling warmly as she speaks. Her gestures are expressive, often touching her baby bump. This is followed by individual interviews of guests and family members in the same setting. (5) Guests are seen engaged in high-energy party games indoors. Some men have balloons stuffed under their shirts to mimic pregnancy, laughing and dancing together. The room is brightly lit with high-end interior design elements like velvet blue chairs. (6) The video returns to the poolside reveal. The couple pulls the release, and a large cluster of pink balloons floats downward while pink smoke rises. The crowd erupts in joy, with guests clapping and cheering. (7) A final wide shot shows the entire group of guests posing together in front of the pool, waving at the camera. The video concludes with a drone shot of a single pink balloon drifting into the vast blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a massive communal countdown in English ('Five, four, three...'), characterized by high vocal arousal and overlapping voices. As the countdown hits 'one,' there is a burst of high-pitched ecstatic screaming and applause. An upbeat, high-tempo pop track with female vocals and a prominent synthesized bass drum begins. (2) The pop music ducks slightly in volume to allow for a clear female voice recording. She speaks with a bright, emotional, and friendly tone in Mandarin. The music maintains a steady 124 BPM rhythm in the background. Subtle indoor room tone is the only ambient noise. (3) Short audio snippets of multiple distinct male and female voices follow. These are edited tightly with 'hard cuts.' Each voice expresses joy or well-wishes. High-frequency 'ding' sound effects are used as transitional markers between speakers. (4) During the montage of party games, the audio mix becomes denser with laughter, the sounds of balloons rustling, and rhythmic clapping synchronized with the beat of the music. A 'whoosh' transition effect bridges the indoor party sounds back to the outdoor pool area. (5) The final phase features a return to the loud, collective cheering of the crowd. The music swells to full volume before a clean fade-out over a final soft chime sound effect.
